Five clicks land at the same spot within about 1 s (events 279, 284, 287, 291, 294), and no navigation, overlay, or error event appears between them, so the user appears to repeat the click while waiting for a result.", "fix": "Fix: On the sales invoice:new \"Apply\" button, disable the button and show a pending indicator as soon as the first click fires, and keep it disabled until the apply handler resolves, so repeated clicks are ignored and the user sees that the action is in progress.", "cited_event_ids": ["279", "284", "287", "291", "294"], "confidence": "med", "unsupported": ["What the Apply action does and how long it takes to complete", "Whether any visual change (spinner, row update, disabled state) occurred between the clicks, since the events do not record rendering", "Why the handler gave no response; 597 pointer samples were dropped, so the cursor path is incomplete", "Whether the later dialog Apply (event 714) is the same control as the affected button", "Whether the console error at event 7 (t=90 ms, before the Apply clicks) relates to this behaviour"]}
